recommended_option: win back 75% of the lost premium mix
headline: Win back three-quarters of the lost premium lines to lift margin rate from 19.9% back to 29.1%.
rationale: High-tier share collapsed from 66.2% to 22.5% and margin rate fell from 32.1% to 19.9%, driven by specific premium lines shrinking or vanishing. Winning back 75% of that lost mix restores the account to healthy without needing to chase the hardest-to-recover fully disappeared lines.
why_not_more_aggressive: 100% recovery only adds a further 3.0pp of margin rate beyond the healthy threshold already met at 75%, for lines that fully disappeared and may be hardest to reclaim.
why_not_less_aggressive: 50% and 33% recovery leave the account short of healthy by 3.1 and 5.2 points respectively — the leak stays structurally unresolved.
expected_result: Recovering 75% of the lost premium mix restores ₹26,051 in margin per month (₹312,607 over 12 months), lifting the margin rate from 19.9% to 29.1% and returning the account to healthy.
what_to_do: Schedule a mix review with the buyer, led by Priya Nair, focused on the Power Tools decline (revenue down 68.8%, from Rs 88,810 to Rs 27,661/month).
Rebuild the proposal around PT-Cordless Drill 18V (was Rs 45,459.50/month, now Rs 5,608.54) and PT-Rotary Hammer SDS (was Rs 29,419.66/month, now Rs 12,077.82).
Raise the two lines that stopped entirely: DG-Thermal Imager (was Rs 28,079/month) and SB-Safety Glasses 10pk (was Rs 8,209/month), and ask why they were dropped.
Rebuild the Precision Hardware line with PH-Micrometer Set (was Rs 16,307.16, now Rs 7,068.24) and PH-Bearing Puller Kit (was Rs 8,127.01, now Rs 920.49).
Set a 6-month checkpoint on margin rate and high-tier revenue share to confirm the recovery is holding.
talking_points: Your premium mix fell from 66.2% to 22.5% of revenue since December 2025.
Margin rate has sat below normal range for 8 months, down from 32.1% to 19.9%.
Power Tools revenue alone dropped 68.8%, from Rs 88,810 to Rs 27,661 a month.
check_before_acting: Whether DG-Thermal Imager and SB-Safety Glasses 10pk were discontinued by the customer or moved to a competitor.
Whether the Power Tools and Diagnostic Equipment declines reflect a competitive loss or an internal supply gap.
Whether any contract terms already lock the customer into the lower-tier substitutes now being bought.
downside_if_wrong: If the disappeared lines cannot be won back, margin recovery falls short of Rs 26,051/month and the account stays below healthy.
timing: Start within 30 days, before next quarterly review
how_we_will_know_it_worked: Margin rate at 6 months should show recovery toward 29.1%, up from 19.9%.
High-tier revenue share should climb back from 22.5% toward pre-decline levels.
PT-Cordless Drill 18V and DG-Insulation Tester monthly revenue should show renewed volume.
